{{Quote|Jerresk was last sighted in the Fordon system, after he and his henchmen attacked a New Republic supply ship en route to the Musson system.|Airen Cracken, ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="Wanted">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>}}
The '''Fordon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="Wanted" /> located within the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Jerresk]] visited the Fordon system after carrying out a raid on a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] traveling to the<ref name="Wanted" /> [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector's]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Musson system/Legends|Musson system]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the former system was listed by the New Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] within the [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'' as Jerresk's last known location.<ref name="Wanted" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fordon system was first mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], which was written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] for [[West End Games]].<ref name="Wanted" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square Q-16.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
